notes: Find a flight: choose regions (Europe and Middle East to start with, or anywhere), and "Anywhere in my regions" as departure.
Your add-on scenery is found in the Community folder by itself: flights are marked "Your scenery", and you can put them first or show only those.
Airport scenery on sale at iniBuilds and Contrail is checked once a day: shown on the flights it fits, and as a list of the best deals in your regions.
